## meaning

On a failure in its error channel it calls `h` with the error, as Zig's `catch |err|` does.

## do-expressions

A `do` or `match` is an expression, and this is the one rule for it inside a larger expression: it runs where JavaScript evaluates the expression that holds it, never earlier or more often.

## do-expressions

Everything to its left runs first, in source order, the callee and a method's receiver included, so `o.m(try a(), match (x) { … })` reads `o.m`, runs `a()`, runs the `match`, and calls the method with `this` as `o`.

## do-expressions

Calls retain ECMA-262's `CallExpression` evaluation, `EvaluateCall` and `ArgumentListEvaluation` behavior, including the receiver, callee lookup, abrupt completions and native non-callable errors; generated invocation machinery must add no observable helper lookup.

## meaning

Native `for...of` and `for await` keep TypeScript's protocol checks and JavaScript meaning, even when their operand also implements `Stream`.

## do-expressions

In a conditional position (one side of `&&`, `||`, `??`, `?:`, `&&=`, `||=`, `??=`, after `?.`, a `case` test, a loop condition or update) it runs only when JavaScript evaluates that position.

## do-expressions

Lowering must preserve the source diagnostic and the native uninitialized-receiver error, including inside lexical arrows.

## destructuring-and-parameter-defaults

Computed keys and assignment targets then run at their native destructuring steps; a default runs only for `undefined`, including a missing value.

## destructuring-and-parameter-defaults

A present value, including `null`, skips its default.

## destructuring-and-parameter-defaults

This also applies when the key, target or default contains `do`.

## destructuring-and-parameter-defaults

A default in an ordinary `function*` or `async function*` runs at the construction call, before the body.

## destructuring-and-parameter-defaults

An outward `return v` there gives an iterator whose first `next()` is `{ done: true, value: v }` and never starts the body.

## meaning

A source-function `return` in a head's per-item defaults or computed keys is `EK1904`, and in `for try` `EK2002`.

## meaning

There is no type-directed `EK2007` rejection or automatic conversion of valid native iteration to `for try`.

## meaning

An outer `restore` cannot cross a nested `effect` function, arrow, method, producer or block: `EK2202`.

## meaning

A nested activation can open its own `uninterruptible` and restore that mask.
